//: The episode manifest. This file is the ORDER; content/levels/*.json is the
CONTENT. Neither is code, and neither requires a code change to extend.
To add a level:   drop <id>.json in content/levels/ and add its id to the
`levels` array of the episode it belongs to.
To add an episode: append an object here and drop its level files in.
The server's LevelLibrary discovers levels on its own by scanning the
directory, so a level missing from this file is still playable and still
appears in /api/levels — it just has no fixed place in the run order and
falls back to its own exit.nextLevelId. An id listed here that has no file
is skipped, so a work-in-progress entry never breaks the campaign.

episodes.name: Knee-Deep in the Blocks
episodes.tagline: Six levels under a UAC landing bay, and every one of them is worse than the last.
